# Coalition for Community Schools

> The Coalition for Community Schools advances equitable school transformation through integrated student supports, family engagement, and community partnerships.

The Coalition for Community Schools, housed within the Institute for Educational Leadership, provides leadership development, technical assistance, and advocacy resources to help schools and districts implement community school models. The organization operates professional networks, conducts research partnerships with institutions like Learning Policy Institute and RAND, and hosts the annual National Community Schools & Family Engagement Conference.

## About the Coalition

- [Community Schools](https://www.communityschools.org): Homepage for Coalition for Community Schools featuring conference and resources.
- [About](https://www.communityschools.org/about): Coalition for Community Schools mission, vision, and organizational overview.
- [Who We Are](https://www.communityschools.org/who-we-are): Institute for Educational Leadership and Coalition leadership team information.
- [What We Do](https://www.communityschools.org/what-we-do): Coalition services: leadership development, advocacy, technical assistance.
- [How We Do It](https://www.communityschools.org/how-we-do-it): Coalition strategy, values, and collaborative framework for school reform.

## Implementation & Resources

- [Learn](https://www.communityschools.org/learn): Learning resources on Community School Standards and implementation.
- [Start a Community School](https://www.communityschools.org/start-a-community-school): Implementation guide with frameworks, playbooks, and financing resources.
- [Scale A Community School](https://www.communityschools.org/scale-community-schools): Scaling strategy and Scale-Up Spiral for district-wide implementation.
- [Messaging and Advocacy Tools](https://www.communityschools.org/learn/scale-community-schools/messaging-and-advocacy-tools): Advocacy templates and messaging guides for policy engagement.

## Research & Evidence

- [Impact](https://www.communityschools.org/impact): Research evidence from LPI, RAND on school improvement and student outcomes.
- [Making the Case](https://www.communityschools.org/making-the-case): Evidence-based resources from Brookings and Children's Aid on community schools.

## Membership & Networks

- [Join the Coalition](https://www.communityschools.org/join-the-coalition): Coalition membership information and guiding principles.
- [Link](https://www.communityschools.org/link): Coalition membership portal and community schools network map.
- [Join a Network](https://www.communityschools.org/join-a-network): Professional networks for coordinators, managers, and school leaders.

## Leadership & Advocacy

- [Lead](https://www.communityschools.org/lead): Leadership development and policy engagement resources.
- [Policy by the People](https://www.communityschools.org/policy-pulse): Federal policy advocacy and grassroots engagement for education policy.

## News & Recognition

- [Community Schools in Action](https://www.communityschools.org/community-schools-in-action): News, case studies, and research on community schools implementation.
- [Awards](https://www.communityschools.org/awards): Recognition of leadership and community school coordinators at annual conference.
